races.long_description: A Republican firearms influencer, Brandon Herrera, is in a tight race with Katy Padilla Stout, a lawyer and former teacher who has highlighted Mr. Herrera’s absolutist views on gun regulations and his inflammatory online rhetoric. Mr. Herrera has cast her as too liberal for a West Texas border district that President Trump won by 15 points in 2024.

Mayor Karen Bass is in the fight of her political life in Los Angeles, where Nithya Raman, a democratic socialist on the City Council, has challenged her. Ms. Bass is up against generational forces, but her absence at the start of the 2025 wildfires also has haunted her.
